name: io.github.otipi-il/otipi-mcp
title: Otipi
description: Send and verify SMS, email and OTP codes in Israel. Free test key, Next.js and Supabase snippets.

environmentVariables.name: OTIPI_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Otipi API key. Use a free sk_test_ key from https://otipi.co.il/signup, or sk_live_ for real sending.

environmentVariables.name: OTIPI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://otipi.co.il.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer followed by an Otipi API key, for example "Bearer sk_test_...". Clients that support OAuth can sign in instead.
